name: Exa Search
summary: Search from Exa's own index, built for AI. $10 of free credit every month (plus a $10 bonus at signup) without a payment method: 2,500 Instant searches a month.

allowance.text: $10 credits every month plus a $10 onboarding bonus, no payment method required

cost_per_query.basic_label: Instant search, up to 10 results ($4 per 1,000; Fast or Auto search: $7 per 1,000)

rate_limits.note: Free plan: 10 search queries per second.

data_logging_note: Exa uses query data to improve its products, including training and fine-tuning the models behind its services.

locale.note: userLocation takes the user's two-letter country code. The search reference has no language parameter.
